inspected_medium: 45 distinct source-owned embedded ~520 px image previews, not originals; prior original-pixel audit available for only three chalice photos
method: First priority plain neutral background and complete, single liturgical object; then sharpness, natural color/lighting, representativeness of Roman-rite use, source license. Distinguish recommendations from user ratings and release approval.

recommendations.label: Chalice
recommendations.rationale: Full traditional chalice with good silhouette against a pale, relatively simple museum display; low distraction. Existing MET white-background image would require cropping to isolate the chalice.
recommendations.restriction: B18 individual image attribution/licence pending. Genoa 1780 is the source-identified fallback; avoid Genoa pre-1777 intruding second chalice and Seville low contrast.

recommendations.label: Paten
recommendations.rationale: Existing MET studio image has almost plain white background and very clear physical shape of the paten at left.
recommendations.restriction: Preferred only after paten-only crop. Source image contains a chalice, so it is not a compliant standalone primary without cropping; Spanish MET is historical-only.

recommendations.label: Ciborium
recommendations.rationale: Single complete covered vessel with distinctive cross, isolated on almost pure neutral background. Strongest immediate teaching silhouette.
recommendations.restriction: Studio image is grayscale and historical; Evellin is clearer color alternate but stylistically austere, not necessarily representative of ordinary 1962 Mass.

recommendations.label: Chalice pall
recommendations.rationale: Full square pall, centered on neutral background; red/gold embroidered IHS is readily recognizable. Pelican pall is also excellent.
recommendations.restriction: B18 creator and individual photo licence not yet checked. Earlier MET textile collage is not a useful isolated pall primary.

recommendations.label: Corporal burse
recommendations.rationale: Single complete square burse photographed straight-on against restrained gray/beige wall. Rich decoration, minimal surrounding objects.
recommendations.restriction: Cooper Hewitt is best white-background alternative; some alternatives include exhibit labels, other textiles or plinths.

recommendations.label: Chalice veil
recommendations.rationale: Complete square veil isolated against black, with clear edge separation and good textile detail.
recommendations.restriction: Historical textile identification only. Need separate in-use image showing a veil over the prepared chalice before using it to teach arrangement.

recommendations.label: Three altar cards
recommendations.rationale: Three good frontal color photos from one coherent Catholic altar-card set. Assemble left, center and right into one correctly ordered teaching illustration, preserving independent source references.
recommendations.restriction: Not three alternative sets. B18 attribution and rights pending. One central card alone is not a representation of all three.

recommendations.label: Wine cruet
recommendations.rationale: The glass and gilt pair is a reasonable combined context photo on a light surface, but it cannot identify which of the two contains wine.
recommendations.restriction: Do not nominate a wine-cruet primary until isolated or documented A/V designation is verified. EQ01 and EQ02 share source.

recommendations.label: Water cruet
recommendations.rationale: The same cleanest cruet-pair photo can illustrate paired liturgical vessels but does not establish which is water.
recommendations.restriction: Do not nominate a water-cruet primary until the individual vessel is identified from the source.
